scripts.test: oxfmt --check && bun run build && oxlint --max-warnings 0 && bun run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: bun run test:unit:node && bun run test:unit:dom
scripts.test:unit:node: bun test --preload ./test-setup/node.ts packages/platforms/android/src packages/platforms/ios/src packages/platforms/profiler/src packages/core/profiler-protocol/src packages/commands/test/src packages/core/reporter/src packages/commands/report/__tests__ packages/core/shell/src
scripts.test:coverage: bun run test:unit:node --coverage && bun run test:unit:dom --coverage
scripts.build: bun run clean-dist && tsc --build && bun run --filter '@lantern/web-reporter' --filter '@lantern/measure' build
